---
title: "People's Bank of China release coverage"
subtitle: "A bilingual, complete-index dashboard built with readPBOC and ggplot2"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
params:
  refresh_index: false
  refresh_text_audit: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 5.8,
  fig.retina = 2,
  out.width = "100%"
)

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
example_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = TRUE))
project_root <- normalizePath(
  file.path(example_dir, "..", ".."),
  mustWork = FALSE
)

if (file.exists(file.path(project_root, "DESCRIPTION"))) {
  pkgload::load_all(project_root, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
  library(readPBOC)
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

index_rds <- file.path(example_dir, "data", "pboc-release-index.rds")
index_csv <- file.path(example_dir, "data", "pboc-release-index.csv")
audit_rds <- file.path(example_dir, "data", "pboc-release-text-audit.rds")
audit_csv <- file.path(example_dir, "data", "pboc-release-text-audit.csv")

if (isTRUE(params$refresh_index)) {
  releases <- pboc_releases(language = "both", pages = "all")
  dir.create(dirname(index_rds), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(releases, index_rds, version = 3)
  utils::write.csv(releases, index_csv, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
} else if (file.exists(index_rds)) {
  releases <- readRDS(index_rds)
} else {
  releases <- pboc_releases(language = "both", pages = "all")
}

release_index <- tibble::as_tibble(releases) |>
  mutate(
    published_at = as.Date(published_at),
    year = as.integer(format(published_at, "%Y")),
    month = factor(
      format(published_at, "%b"),
      levels = month.abb,
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    language_label = recode(
      language,
      zh = "Chinese",
      en = "English"
    ),
    feed = recode(
      category,
      data_interpretation = "Chinese data interpretation",
      aggregate_financing = "English aggregate financing",
      financial_markets = "English financial markets",
      financial_statistics = "English financial statistics",
      general = "English general releases",
      other = "English other statistics"
    )
  )

language_colours <- c(
  Chinese = "#A61B29",
  English = "#265D84"
)

theme_pboc <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#4A5560"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E8EBED"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "#4A5560")
    )
}

feed_summary <- release_index |>
  group_by(language_label, feed) |>
  summarise(
    releases = n(),
    index_pages = n_distinct(source_url),
    earliest = min(published_at),
    latest = max(published_at),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annual_counts <- release_index |>
  count(year, language_label, name = "releases")

category_counts <- release_index |>
  count(feed, language_label, name = "releases")

heatmap_counts <- release_index |>
  count(feed, year, name = "releases")

monthly_counts <- release_index |>
  count(year, month, language_label, name = "releases")

completeness <- tibble::tibble(
  field = c(
    "Release identifier",
    "Language",
    "Category",
    "Title",
    "Publication date",
    "Release URL",
    "Source-page URL"
  ),
  complete = c(
    sum(!is.na(release_index$release_id) &
          nzchar(release_index$release_id)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$language) &
          nzchar(release_index$language)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$category) &
          nzchar(release_index$category)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$title) &
          nzchar(release_index$title)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$published_at)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$url) &
          nzchar(release_index$url)),
    sum(!is.na(release_index$source_url) &
          nzchar(release_index$source_url))
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    total = nrow(release_index),
    share = complete / total
  )

run_text_audit <- function(index) {
  split_rows <- split(
    seq_len(nrow(index)),
    interaction(index$language, index$category, drop = TRUE)
  )
  jobs <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(split_rows, function(rows) {
      data.frame(
        row = c(
          rows[which.min(index$published_at[rows])],
          rows[which.max(index$published_at[rows])]
        ),
        endpoint = c("Earliest", "Latest")
      )
    })
  )

  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(i) {
    record <- index[jobs$row[i], , drop = FALSE]
    tryCatch(
      {
        document <- pboc_read_release(record)
        tibble::tibble(
          release_id = record$release_id,
          language = record$language,
          category = record$category,
          title = record$title,
          published_at = record$published_at,
          url = record$url,
          endpoint = jobs$endpoint[i],
          status = "retrieved",
          text_characters = nchar(document$text),
          paragraphs = length(document$paragraphs),
          attachments = nrow(document$attachments)
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        tibble::tibble(
          release_id = record$release_id,
          language = record$language,
          category = record$category,
          title = record$title,
          published_at = record$published_at,
          url = record$url,
          endpoint = jobs$endpoint[i],
          status = conditionMessage(e),
          text_characters = NA_integer_,
          paragraphs = NA_integer_,
          attachments = NA_integer_
        )
      }
    )
  })

  bind_rows(rows)
}

if (isTRUE(params$refresh_text_audit)) {
  text_audit <- run_text_audit(release_index)
  dir.create(dirname(audit_rds), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(text_audit, audit_rds, version = 3)
  utils::write.csv(text_audit, audit_csv, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
} else if (file.exists(audit_rds)) {
  text_audit <- tibble::as_tibble(readRDS(audit_rds))
} else {
  text_audit <- run_text_audit(release_index)
}

text_audit <- text_audit |>
  mutate(
    published_at = as.Date(published_at),
    endpoint = factor(
      tools::toTitleCase(endpoint),
      levels = c("Earliest", "Latest")
    ),
    feed = recode(
      category,
      data_interpretation = "Chinese data interpretation",
      aggregate_financing = "English aggregate financing",
      financial_markets = "English financial markets",
      financial_statistics = "English financial statistics",
      general = "English general releases",
      other = "English other statistics"
    )
  )

snapshot_time <- file.info(index_rds)$mtime
if (is.na(snapshot_time)) snapshot_time <- Sys.time()
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
.dashboard-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(145px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 18px 0 26px 0;
}
.dashboard-metric {
  border-top: 4px solid #a61b29;
  background: #f5f7f8;
  padding: 15px 16px;
}
.dashboard-metric-value {
  display: block;
  color: #18222b;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.dashboard-metric-label {
  color: #52606b;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.coverage-note {
  border-left: 4px solid #265d84;
  background: #f3f7fa;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .dashboard-metrics {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(130px, 1fr));
  }
}
```

This dashboard calls `readPBOC` to traverse every page reported by every
configured Chinese and English release index. Its charts and searchable
inventory use every indexed release. The frozen snapshot provides a
reproducible view, and the refresh parameters rebuild it directly from the
official PBOC websites.

```{r metrics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(
  '<div class="dashboard-metrics">',
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Unique releases</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    comma(nrow(release_index))
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Official release feeds</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    n_distinct(release_index$feed)
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Index pages traversed</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    comma(n_distinct(release_index$source_url))
  ),
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="dashboard-metric">',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-value">%s–%s</span>',
      '<span class="dashboard-metric-label">Publication span</span>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    format(min(release_index$published_at), "%Y"),
    format(max(release_index$published_at), "%Y")
  ),
  '</div>'
)
```

<div class="coverage-note">
Snapshot retrieved at `r format(snapshot_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")`.
It spans `r format(min(release_index$published_at), "%d %B %Y")` through
`r format(max(release_index$published_at), "%d %B %Y")`.
</div>

## Release history {.tabset}

### Annual coverage

Every annual bar uses the complete bilingual release index.

```{r annual-coverage}
ggplot(
  annual_counts,
  aes(x = year, y = releases, fill = language_label)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.84, preserve = "single")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = language_colours) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      floor(min(annual_counts$year) / 5) * 5,
      max(annual_counts$year),
      by = 5
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "PBOC releases indexed by year and website language",
    subtitle = paste(
      "All",
      comma(nrow(release_index)),
      "release records contribute to the annual counts"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Releases"
  ) +
  theme_pboc()
```

### Cumulative archive

```{r cumulative-coverage}
cumulative <- release_index |>
  arrange(language_label, published_at, release_id) |>
  group_by(language_label) |>
  mutate(releases = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(
  cumulative,
  aes(x = published_at, y = releases, colour = language_label)
) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = language_colours) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative releases across both official websites",
    subtitle = "The Chinese and English archives form two independently indexed histories",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative releases"
  ) +
  theme_pboc()
```

### Monthly cadence

```{r monthly-cadence}
ggplot(
  monthly_counts,
  aes(x = year, y = month, fill = releases)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ language_label, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EEF2F4", high = "#A61B29") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      floor(min(monthly_counts$year) / 5) * 5,
      max(monthly_counts$year),
      by = 5
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Release cadence by month",
    subtitle = "Darker cells contain more releases",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Releases"
  ) +
  theme_pboc() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## Feed coverage {.tabset}

### Releases by feed

```{r releases-by-feed}
ggplot(
  category_counts,
  aes(
    x = reorder(feed, releases),
    y = releases,
    fill = language_label
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(releases)),
    hjust = -0.12,
    colour = "#28343D",
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = language_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Every configured release feed contributes to the index",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Releases"
  ) +
  theme_pboc()
```

### Feed history

```{r feed-history, fig.height=6.8}
ggplot(
  heatmap_counts,
  aes(x = year, y = feed, fill = releases)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EEF2F4", high = "#A61B29") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      floor(min(heatmap_counts$year) / 5) * 5,
      max(heatmap_counts$year),
      by = 5
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Each feed's full publication history",
    subtitle = "Every cell counts release records from the complete index",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Releases"
  ) +
  theme_pboc() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

### Feed totals

```{r feed-summary}
knitr::kable(
  feed_summary |>
    arrange(language_label, desc(releases)) |>
    transmute(
      Language = language_label,
      Feed = feed,
      Releases = releases,
      `Index pages` = index_pages,
      Earliest = format(earliest, "%Y-%m-%d"),
      Latest = format(latest, "%Y-%m-%d")
    ),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "l", "l")
)
```

## Coverage audit {.tabset}

### Metadata completeness

```{r metadata-completeness}
ggplot(
  completeness,
  aes(x = reorder(field, share), y = share)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#265D84", width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = 1.15,
    colour = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Every indexed release carries complete provenance metadata",
    subtitle = paste(
      comma(nrow(release_index)),
      "unique release URLs and",
      comma(n_distinct(release_index$release_id)),
      "unique release identifiers"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Complete records"
  ) +
  theme_pboc() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Text extraction

`pboc_read_release()` retrieves article text, paragraph boundaries, and
attachment links. The audit exercises the earliest and latest release in every
configured feed, covering both current and legacy page structures.

```{r text-extraction}
ggplot(
  text_audit,
  aes(
    x = feed,
    y = text_characters,
    colour = endpoint,
    group = feed
  )
) +
  geom_line(colour = "#C9CED3", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(Earliest = "#265D84", Latest = "#A61B29")
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Statement text retrieved across every feed's archive endpoints",
    subtitle = paste(
      sum(text_audit$status == "retrieved"),
      "of",
      nrow(text_audit),
      "endpoint releases retrieved successfully"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Text characters, logarithmic scale"
  ) +
  theme_pboc()
```

```{r text-audit-table}
knitr::kable(
  text_audit |>
    arrange(feed, endpoint) |>
    transmute(
      Feed = feed,
      Endpoint = endpoint,
      Date = format(published_at, "%Y-%m-%d"),
      Status = status,
      `Text characters` = text_characters,
      Paragraphs = paragraphs,
      Attachments = attachments
    ),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

## Every release

The table contains every release in the snapshot. Search and column filters
provide direct access to titles, dates, languages, feeds, identifiers, official
release URLs, and the exact index page where each record was discovered.

```{r complete-inventory, echo=FALSE}
inventory <- release_index |>
  arrange(desc(published_at), language, category, title) |>
  transmute(
    Date = format(published_at, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    Language = language_label,
    Feed = feed,
    Title = title,
    `Release ID` = release_id,
    `Official release URL` = url,
    `Official index page` = source_url
  )

DT::datatable(
  inventory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    lengthMenu = c(20, 50, 100),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    order = list(list(0, "desc"))
  )
)
```

## Rebuild the evidence

Render the frozen snapshot:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
  "inst/examples/pboc-release-coverage-dashboard.Rmd"
)
```

Refresh every index page and both endpoints of every release feed, then render:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
  "inst/examples/pboc-release-coverage-dashboard.Rmd",
  params = list(
    refresh_index = TRUE,
    refresh_text_audit = TRUE
  )
)
```

The refresh path calls these public package functions:

```r
all_releases <- pboc_releases(
  language = "both",
  pages = "all"
)

one_statement <- pboc_read_release(all_releases[1, ])
```
